name: cp2
description: Test cases without the clicking: implicit problems, text-file cases, stress testing, one-key sample import and submit for Codeforces / AtCoder. Reads your existing .cph data.

colors.description: Explorer colour for partially accepted problems

cp2.cpp.flags.markdownDescription: Flags for normal runs. Empty: `cph.language.cpp.Args`, else `-std=gnu++20 -DLOCAL -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all`. On native Windows (MinGW) the address sanitizer is dropped automatically.

cp2.cpp.judgeFlags.markdownDescription: Flags used when a problem's **Judge flags** box is ticked (for tight time limits).

cp2.timeLimitMs.markdownDescription: Time limit when a problem has none. 0: `cph.general.timeOut`, else 3000.

cp2.stackMb.description: Stack size for programs (MB). Deep recursion behaves like on Codeforces.

cp2.outputLimitMb.description: Programs printing more than this are stopped (OLE).

cp2.ignoreStderr.markdownDescription: Non-empty stderr doesn't fail a case. Unset: `cph.general.ignoreSTDERROR`, else true.

cp2.inlineKb.description: Cases larger than this are shown as a preview with an 'open in editor' button.

cp2.precompiledHeaders.enabled.description: Precompile bits/stdc++.h / bits/extc++.h per flag set (~4x faster compiles; ~200 MB each in the cache folder).

cp2.cacheDir.description: Where precompiled headers are kept. Empty: ~/.cache/cp2.

cp2.stress.waFlags.description: Flags for sus/brute/gen in WA stress (no -DLOCAL, so debug output is compiled out).

cp2.stress.reFlags.description: Flags for sus in RE stress.

cp2.stress.maxIterations.description: Stop after this many runs without a failure (0 = until stopped).

cp2.stress.helperTimeoutMs.description: Time limit for gen and brute.

cp2.stress.genTemplate.description: Template for new gen files (relative to the workspace root). Snippet syntax like $0 is allowed.

cp2.stress.shrinkSeconds.markdownDescription: After a stress failure, how long to keep looking for a smaller failing test (the **smaller** slider). Used in folders where the slider hasn't been moved.

cp2.newFile.snippet.description: Snippet (name or prefix) written into files created by Write Contest.

cp2.newFile.extension.description: Extension of files created by Write Contest.

cp2.contest.folders.markdownDescription: Suggested folders for Write Contest, e.g. `{"codeforces": "codeforces/${contestId}", "atcoder.abc": "atcoder/beginner/${hundreds}xx/${number}"}`.

cp2.submit.languages.markdownDescription: Regexes picking the submit language per site and file type, e.g. `{"codeforces": {"cpp": ["G\\+\\+ ?23"]}}`.

cp2.submit.confirm.description: Ask before submitting when the last run had failures or the file changed since it was last run.
